entities.summary: Vitali Nikolayevich Koval is a Belarusian professional ice hockey goaltender. He has previously played for Molot-Prikamye Perm, Dinamo Minsk, Torpedo Nizhny Novgorod and Atlant Moscow Oblast, Salavat Yulaev Ufa with whom reached Gagarin Cup Final in 2011.
